svg.aria-label: Research statement: I am interested in how electronic markets work beneath the charts. My work focuses on designing reproducible experiments, building research infrastructure, and validating quantitative ideas against real market data. Most of what I know came from watching promising strategies fail under honest validation. That changed how I structure research: data integrity first, then evaluation, then models.
